Test Scenario: Create Ankit survey with valid offline survey payload
Preconditions: Mock API server is running and Postman environment is configured
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /sync-survey with valid Ankit payload. 2. Validate HTTP response. 3. Validate response fields.
Expected Result: HTTP 201 Created. Response status is success. sync_id, local_id and device_id match the request. A non-empty server_id is generated.
Actual Result: Passed on initial creation. Subsequent identical execution returns 200 as an already-synchronized response.

Test Scenario: Synchronize Pooja survey using the same local_id as Ankit
Preconditions: Ankit survey has been synchronized. Mock API server is running
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /sync-survey with Pooja payload. 2. Use same local_id as Ankit. 3. Use different device_id and sync_id. 4. Validate response and stored records.
Expected Result: Pooja's survey is stored independently. Ankit's record is not overwritten. Pooja receives a different server_id.
Actual Result: Passed. Two separate server records exist with different server_id values.

Test Scenario: Retry an already synchronized Ankit survey

Expected Result: Server recognizes existing sync_id, returns successful already-synchronized response, keeps same server_id, and does not create duplicate record.
